title: Gateway project
description: One project of the model and tool gateway (docs/agentgateway.md). scripts/gen-projects.py checks this schema plus the cross-file rules it can't express.

project.description: The project id. Must match the file name.

owner.description: Who answers for this project: a team or a person.

data_class.description: The most sensitive data the project sends. Caps the placements it may use (policies/gateway/data.json classes).

placement.description: Where the project's requests may go. Optional; defaults to everything its data_class allows, and may only narrow that.

allow.description: Glob patterns over catalog model names (catalog/models.yaml). Defaults to ["*"]. Each pattern must match at least one catalog model.

routing.description: How model "auto" picks a model for this project, always among the models it may use. cheapest: lowest price in catalog/models.yaml. fastest: lowest time to first token measured by the ranking job, cheapest first where none is known yet. semantic: the vLLM Semantic Router names the task class and catalog tasks give the order, cheapest as the fallback. fixed:<model>: always that model. Default: cheapest.

limits.description: Rate limits, shared by all of the project's keys and all gateway replicas (rate-limit service). Absent: no limit. Tokens are counted when a call completes, so the call that crosses the limit still finishes and the next one is refused.

budget.description: Spend cap in USD over a fixed 30-day window (the rate-limit service's month: 30-day periods counted from the Unix epoch, not calendar months), at agentgateway's prices (catalog/models.yaml). Self-hosted models cost nothing. Charged when a call completes, so the call that crosses the cap still finishes. Absent: no cap.

keys.description: Ids of the project's own API keys. The secrets themselves are in Vault (scripts/bootstrap-vault-secrets.sh). A key whose id is not listed here or by one of the project's agents (agents/*.yaml) is refused. Each id is the project id, or the project id followed by a dash and a suffix. May be empty when every key belongs to an agent.

mcp_tools.description: Glob patterns over the gateway's MCP tool names (grafana_..., kagent-tools_...). Empty or absent: no MCP access.
